text:
samir: Heads-up: planning a maintenance window for az6 rack01 — PDU swap + control-plane micro-reboot. Need to stagger node drains to keep latency SLOs. Proposed window: Sun 2026-04-04 02:00-05:00 UTC. Who can help coordinate?

mira: what's our fallback capacity? can we push traffic to dedicated pools in us-east-1/az2 without hitting egress quotas?

alex: we have two reserved pools with ~30% spare. Cross-region routing is possible but egress could spike. Recommend pre-warm hot-key caches and set routing weights 0.75->0.25 for 30m while cohorts move.

ops-bot: [scheduled] Maintenance created by samir for Sun 2026-04-04 02:00 UTC — channel: #eng-infra :calendar: 

jonah: cost heads-up — full region failover will add ~ $2k/hr in egress during the window. If we limit to intra-region fallback and stagger, estimate ~ $350-500/hr. Spot churn might also add small overhead.

lia: suggested plan: canary cohort of 3 nodes -> small cohort 10 -> larger 30 -> remaining rack. Wait 7m between cohorts, monitor 95/99p latency and error rate. Abort if 99p > 1.5x baseline or errors > 0.5%.

samir: agreed. I'll run the cordon/drain sequence and tag hosts. Example drain steps I'll use:
```bash
kubectl cordon node-rack01-0
kubectl drain node-rack01-0 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=120
sleep 420
kubectl uncordon node-rack01-0
```

samir: also will tag hosts with maintenance=az6-2026-04-04 so routing rules can exclude them during cohorts; will flip routing weights in console for the fallback window.

mira: for cache warmup, plan to prefetch top hot prefixes. Quick job (run at 01:20 UTC):
```python
# prefetch script (pseudo)
for p in top_prefixes(100):
    api.prefetch(prefix=p, timeout=30)
```

alex: dashboards to watch: /dashboards/latency/token-slo, /dashboards/pool-utilization, /dashboards/egress-cost. I'll add a temporary alert on 99p latency and a throttle-once threshold. I'll also prepare a console route fallback change (75/25) for 15m blocks.

samir: calling oncall for the window — @priya can you take primary? i'll be backup.

priya: I'm available. I'll be online 01:30-05:30 UTC. :thumbsup:

mira: i'll kick the prewarm job at 01:20 UTC and coordinate with alex to validate metrics before the first cohort.

jonah: i'll watch billing/egress and will abort cross-region if the cost delta exceeds our threshold.

samir: thanks all. Plan summary: canary -> staged cohorts -> full rack, 7m waits, prewarm caches, routing weight flip, tag hosts. Abort conditions noted. I'll post the runbook link shortly after I push the maintenance ticket.

priya: :white_check_mark:
